project.title: Jaka Tingkir EP1 — Master Reference Image Batch
project.style: cinematic realistic, Javanese period drama, dark-fantasy tones

instructions_for_agent.purpose: Generate 12 master reference images untuk EP1 Jaka Tingkir Series. Single phase, no dependency, parallel.

phase_master_ref.description: Generate 12 image (8 karakter 5-angle + 4 artefak macro). Tidak ada dependency antar job — boleh parallel semua.

instructions_for_agent.reuse_note: EP1 juga akan pakai 5 master ref yang SUDAH ADA (tidak perlu generate ulang): 3B-K001-sultan-trenggana (Pangeran Trenggana), 3A-K003-sunan-kalijaga (Sunan Kalijaga), 3B-L001-demak (Demak lokasi), 3B-S001-pendapa-demak (Pendapa scene), 3A-L002-malaka (Malaka lokasi).

qc_check.konsistensi_karakter: 5-angle dalam 1 K image harus menunjukkan karakter yang sama
qc_check.no_modern_elements: Tidak boleh ada modern elements (kabel, aspal, building modern, electric lights)

phases.name: Generate Master Reference Images untuk EP1

jobs.prompt:
Cinematic realistic character reference sheet of Raden Patah (Panembahan Jiem-Boen / Sultan Syah Alam Akbar Jiem-Boen-ningrat I), founder of Demak Bintara Sultanate, late 15th-early 16th century (1478-1518 AD), East Java — shown in 5 different angles arranged in a horizontal grid layout on a clean solid light cream studio background. Layout: left-to-right — frontal face close-up, full body front view, side face profile close-up, side full body view holding the royal keris, back full body view. All 5 angles show the exact same single character, same costume, same physical features, same identity. Male, late 60s to early 70s, weathered wise face with deep wrinkles around eyes and forehead, long flowing white beard reaching mid-chest, kind but authoritative dark brown eyes beneath thick white eyebrows. Bald crown with long white hair at sides flowing to shoulders. Wearing royal yellow silk robe with golden thread embroidery of Islamic calligraphy patterns, dark green sash across chest, white turban with golden crescent pin, dark sarung with batik parang pattern. Heavy gold necklace with Arabic inscriptions, gold ring on right index finger, holding a wooden staff with ivory handle. Bare feet in leather sandals. Calm, wise, kingly presence. Clean studio background, no environment, no historical setting, no other characters.

Lighting: studio 5500K even key light from above-front, soft fill from left, low ambient. Even neutral lighting for character reference, no dramatic lighting.

Mood: neutral studio reference, character turnaround for production consistency. Founder of Demak Bintara — descendant of Brawijaya V (Majapahit) and Putri Cempa (Chinese Muslim), established first Islamic sultanate in Java 1478, ruled until death 1518.

Style: photorealistic skin texture with visible pores and age spots, white hair with individual strand detail, 35mm film grain, deep depth of field f/8, 50mm lens, 8K hyperdetailed, color graded neutral, production reference aesthetic. Aspect ratio 16:9 horizontal. High detail, 4K, sharp focus.

jobs.prompt:

The blade shows damascene pamor patterns in silvery-gray against darker iron, with the head of a dragon (naga) carved in relief near the base (ganja). The hilt (dhuwung) is carved from dark buffalo horn in the form of a coiled naga with open mouth, eyes originally inlaid with rubies. The mendhak (hilt ring) is of beaten gold. The warangka (sheath) is carved from pelet wood with natural grain patterns, bound with gold. Displayed diagonally against a dark slate background for studio macro shot. Empty, no people.

Lighting: studio macro — 4200K soft key light from upper-left at 30 degrees highlighting the pamor pattern, gentle fill from right, dark neutral background. Even macro lighting to reveal blade texture and carving detail.

Mood: mystical, dangerous, royal heirloom. Legendary keris said to have "bitten" the back of Sultan Raden Yunus II causing his death in 1521 (per traditional tale). Symbol of supernatural power and fate.

Style: photorealistic macro photography, 100mm macro lens, f/8 deep depth of field for product detail, 8K hyperdetailed pamor pattern, color graded neutral with cool iron tones. Aspect ratio 1:1 square. High detail, 4K, sharp focus.
